compatibility.rule: candidate edges are not promoted to verified without explicit evidence

source_policy: Do not infer technical specifications from product titles.
Woo product ID/SKU and explicit Woo/manufacturer/supplier data may be authoritative; title-derived values remain candidates until verified.
HTML, schema and future feeds must resolve to one canonical product-data source.
closure_requirements: Collect authoritative catalog/supplier data for required family attributes and identifiers.
Add real product galleries/videos where only one image exists.
Re-run Top30 gate until each promoted priority product reaches the agreed >=85 quality threshold without fabricated fields.
